literal_meaning: মৃতদেহের জন্য কান্না (crying for the dead body)
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাড়িতে মড়াকান্নার শব্দ শুনে সবাই ছুটে এল।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone joined in loud wailing together.
The sound of wailing reached everyone's ears, and they all rushed over.
history: Refers to traditional Bengali funeral practices where mourners, especially women, express grief through loud collective wailing.
note: Commonly used in contexts of death and mourning in Bengali society.
